description: This file defines the 'PayPalEvents' class, which handles PayPal payment processing and callbacks within the Apache OFBiz e-commerce framework. It includes methods for initiating PayPal payments, handling IPN (Instant Payment Notification) callbacks, canceling orders, and updating payment preferences based on PayPal responses.

classes.name: PayPalEvents
classes.description: Contains static methods for initiating PayPal payments, handling IPN notifications, canceling orders, and updating payment preferences within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: callPayPal
methods.description: Initiates a PayPal payment by constructing the redirect URL with necessary parameters based on the order and product store configurations, then redirects the user to PayPal.

methods.name: payPalIPN
methods.description: Handles PayPal IPN notifications by verifying the request with PayPal, updating order status, and recording payment details within a transactional scope.

methods.name: cancelPayPalOrder
methods.description: Handles user cancellation of a PayPal order, cancels the related order in OFBiz, and commits or rolls back the transaction accordingly.
